text.description_html:
Laurey 54039, Velma 3 Inch Satin Chrome Cabinet Pull

With its sexy, vintage silhouette the Velma Cabinet Pull will bring unique character to any lightweight door or drawer. The Laurey 54039 Pull comes with the installation hardware for use on kitchen cabinets or as a furniture drawer pull. The Velma Satin Chrome Cabinet Pull has 3 inch mounting centers and is 4 inches overall.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 3 Inch Velma Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Sold Individually
